acceptanceCriteria: On Darwin the memory signal is the kernel memory-pressure level (kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level), or the swap-out rate, not the swap used/total level; a high but static swap level alone no longer holds level 2.
The signal that set the current level is reported (reason: memory/swap/load) in dispatch status and the throttled event.
An unavailable signal is NOT_OBSERVED/uncertainty and does not fabricate calm or pressure; Linux behaviour is unchanged.
Spec CAL-V0-068 (agent-leases) is updated with numbered requirements, and maintained tests cover a sticky-swap sample with normal pressure level dropping the level.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

GitHub beamfall/corvint#636 (main-2fff511). CAL-V0-068 pressure throttle on Darwin (source darwin-sysctl-host) sat at level 2 all day: load 63.4 on 10 CPUs and swap used 0.85, while the Colima VM had a load of 2.5 on 8 vCPUs and memory_pressure showed 39% free. vm.swapusage used is sticky on macOS, and the load average counts Virtualization.framework vCPU threads. The operator workaround raised the thresholds (swap 0.95/0.98 calm 0.90, load per CPU 4.5/7.0 calm 3.0).

completion.reason: Landed in beamfall/corvint PR #638, merge 3dc863bd75e163d723a5b116060caef2317d2d8a (fixes GitHub issue #636). Darwin memory signal is kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level (1 calm, 2 -> level>=1, 4 -> level 2); swap used/total no longer holds level 2. The setting signal is recorded as reason (memory/swap/load) in dispatch status and the throttled event. An unavailable reading is NOT_OBSERVED and never falls back to swap; Linux is unchanged. Spec CAL-V0-109..110 in corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md. Maintained tests cover sticky swap with normal pressure dropping the level; focused dispatch/store/cli tests passed locally and all hosted CI checks passed on the merge head. A live Darwin sample is recorded in the build log. Limits: live dispatcher saturation NOT_RUN; an older binary refuses the new ledger fields (downgrade: start the dispatcher once without pressure).

title: dispatch pressure throttle: macOS sticky swap level and VM-inflated load average pin the throttle at level 2 (issue 636)
